commits.headline: feat(nonmatching): func_L00_00286068 near miss accepted for the port
commits.author: Lynder063
commits.body:
Reads the instructions: it scans a row's 64 four-byte slots from the last down
for the wanted value (v + 1) or a free one, stores it there and returns the
index, or -1 (also for v < 0). The near miss does exactly that; it only compiles
8 bytes shorter (the first iteration is peeled in retail). Blocked levels 2, 3,
8, 9, 13 and 14.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01HnBWRX56NfvfSTkUri24bZ
